Hi Yves, I'm trying to fit a CFA model with variable names in Chinese but I failed.

I've searched the posts and found you kindly solved similar problem(variable names in Korean).

Here is my model syntax.

憂鬱情緒 =~ 悲傷 + 恐懼 + 寂寞 + 痛哭 + 煩惱 + 失敗 + 悶悶不樂
身體問題 =~ 困擾 + 費力 + 不專心 + 睡眠 + 寡言 + 無力 + 胃口不好
人際困擾 =~ 不友善 + 不喜歡
正向情緒 =~ 良好 + 樂趣 + 快樂 + 希望
'

If it is not too bothering, is it possible to fix it?

Thanks!

Chung-Ping
